d.ko:
Obenseuer is an urban survival RPG where you become the property manager of a run-down, unfinished tenement building in the isolated quarantine district of Obenseuer.

Maintain and upgrade your tenement for rent, uncover the secrets of this infamous district and grow your wealth with your craft.

rv.t: Obenseuer라는 똥통에 갇혀 아파트를 발전시키고, 지역을 휩쓴 전염병과 이 지역에 대한 비밀을 파헤쳐나가는 게임입니다. 전투 요소는 일절 없으며 탐험, 파밍, 생산, 생존에 초점이 맞춰진 게임이기에 NPC를 두들겨 패는 것을 좋아하시면 별로일 것 같습니다. …
끊임없이 가난하고 몸이 아파서 플레이 하기가 괴로운데, 그 때문에 계속 하게 됨. 그런데 그게 해결되면 게임도 끝나버림. 행복에 도달하기위해 끊임없이 괴로워해야하는 게임임. 플레이는 굉장히 불친절함. …
Its basically Stardew Valley but set in a toxic cesspool full of chemically addicted Finnish people.
250 hours in. This game is an absolute misery grind and takes a bit to get your head around and your feet under you, but there is tons to keep you occupied and master. …

For the love of god please hold off on buying this until it's fully developed and released. As it stands this game is a ginormous time investment for little return and there's nothing worse than spending entire days farming for upgrades to …
